description: Step 2 of 2: send the message from trnch_register_message and its signature; returns { key, prefix, wallet } with status 201. The key is shown once, store it. The wallet must hold 10 USDG or 0.004 ETH on Robinhood Chain (402 otherwise); 3 keys max per wallet (409); 400 if the signature or message does not match.

label.description: Optional name for the key, e.g. the agent name.

message.description: The message returned by trnch_register_message, unchanged.

ref.description: Optional referral code of the agent's builder: its owner earns a share of the fees of this key's swaps.

signature.description: personal_sign signature of message by wallet.

name: trnch_register
title: Create an API key
